title: Sdk API
description: API for kozibrodka's warfare themed mods in Beta 1.7.3 on Fabric + Station API supporting both client and server.
body:
### What's Sdk API
This mod itself doesnt add any content to the game. Its an API/Base mod for upcoming kozibrodka's warfare themed mods for beta 1.7.3 on Babric+Station API. Its important for this project to have modrinth page as other mods will use it as a hard dependency. Sdk Api provides high level of compability and in-between-mods interactions for all mods that will use it.

### API Features
Api provides templates for crucial systems of every warfare themed mod. Sdk Api's config will take effect on all its mods. Api proved templates for several sections of features:
- **Guns:** Customizable with more than 35 variables including custom sounds, recoil, damage, velocity, hud icons and more.
- **Bullets:** Advanced Ballistics including richochets, Liquid behaviour, Impact sounds dependact on collision, penetration system and more.
- **Shells:** Template for rockets, bullets that explode on contact
- **Bullet Casings:** Ability do add casings to every bullet
- **Controlable vehicles:** Interfaces that help creating your own vehicle using existing keybinds in api, also support hud for all vehicles.
- **Grenades:**
Nade item Entities with bouncable physics.
- **Utilities:**
Templates for Parachutes, NightVisionGoogles, ScubaTanks, Yetpacks
- **Server Optimalization Systems:**
Server constantly searches for frozen bullet entities on Loaded chunk borders and kills them preventing lags
- **No Visible Player Tags:**
Hardcore mode, changes dynamic of PVP and Stealth gameplay, togglable
- **Keybinds:** so that mods wont double on adding them
- **Config:**
Multiplayer synced settings to adjust gameplay for your preferences
- **Particles:** Particle effects with unlimited render distance
